uiLanguage.name: Module language
uiLanguage.hint: Language of the Table Compass for you. Follow Foundry uses Foundry's language.

theme.name: Look
theme.hint: Warm paper colors or the dark colors of Foundry, for you.

minVotes.name: Votes before anything shows
minVotes.hint: A scale, a scene check and the feedback round show results only from this many answers on, so a single vote cannot be told apart. 1 shows everything at once.

updateDelay.name: Delay of the GM's view
updateDelay.hint: New votes reach the GM's window after a random wait, so a click cannot be matched to the player who just moved. The X card always arrives at once.

fadeMinutes.name: Votes fade after (minutes)
fadeMinutes.hint: A vote on a scale counts for this long, so the picture belongs to the current scene. Players can renew it at any time.

signalMinutes.name: Signals last (minutes)
signalMinutes.hint: How long a signal such as a break request stays, unless the GM ticks it off earlier.

freeText.name: Free text in the feedback round
freeText.hint: Players may write a rose, a thorn and a bud. Free text can reveal its writer by style, the form says so.

xcardSound.name: Sound for the X card
xcardSound.hint: The GM's client plays a short sound when a player shows the X card.

Keybinding.openHint: The GM's view for a GM, the players' window for a player.

XCard.name: X card
XCard.alert: X card: a player would like to skip the current topic.
XCard.waiting: X card shown, waiting for the GM
XCard.sent: The GM sees it at once. Nobody learns who it was.
XCard.acknowledged: The GM has seen the X card.

Notice.newSession: A new session of the Table Compass has started.

GM.newSessionConfirm: Start a new session? Votes, signals, wishes and the history start again. The results of earlier feedback rounds stay.
GM.signalTitle: {signal}: {count}. Click to tick it off for everyone.
GM.pollFew: Scene check: too few answers ({count}) to show
GM.single: Only one player is online: their votes cannot be anonymous.
GM.empty: No votes yet. Players open the compass in the token controls.
GM.historyEmpty: The history fills in during the session.

Player.anonymous: Anonymous: the GM sees what the table thinks, never who said what.
Player.wishSoon: {wish}: the GM announced it as coming soon
Player.noGM: No GM is online. What you say is sent as soon as a GM joins.
Player.single: You are the only player online, so the GM can tell your votes apart.
Player.queued: No GM is online. It goes out as soon as a GM joins.
Player.sent: Sent to the GM, without your name.
Player.wishSent: Wish sent to the GM, without your name.
Player.fade: Middle means fine. Your vote fades after {minutes} minutes.

Poll.title: Scene check
Poll.question: How was the scene?
Poll.hint: The GM sees how the scene went only when the time is up, never who answered what.
Poll.thanks: Thank you! You can change your answer until the time is up.

Feedback.title: Feedback round
Feedback.anonymous: Anonymous. The GM gets a summary of all answers, never your name. Being honest helps the whole table.
Feedback.bud: Bud: what are you looking forward to?
Feedback.styleHint: Free text can reveal you by your writing style. Leave it empty to stay fully anonymous.
Feedback.thanksText: Your feedback reached the GM without your name. You can change it until the GM closes the round.

Results.title: Feedback rounds
Results.few: Only {count} answers. Results show from {min} answers on, so nobody can be recognized.
Results.saved: Saved in the journal entry Table Compass, only GMs can see it.
Results.noneYet: No feedback round yet. Start one from the GM's window at the end of the session.

Choices.title: Scales, signals and wishes
Choices.menuHint: What the players' window offers at this table.
Choices.axesHint: Each scale has fine in the middle and two ends.
Choices.signalsHint: Quick signals for the moment. The X card is always there.

SELFTEST.Title: Table Compass self test
SELFTEST.Hint: Checks the socket, the GM, the storage and the texts of the module.
SELFTEST.NoGM: No GM is active, votes cannot be collected.
SELFTEST.Storage: The storage of the module is not registered.
SELFTEST.Vote: A test vote did not pass the checks.
SELFTEST.Single: Only one player is online, so votes cannot be anonymous right now.
SELFTEST.NewVersions: Table Compass was verified with an earlier version: {versions}. Run the self test in the module settings.

DEBUG.Title: Debug file
DEBUG.Hint: Saves one file for bug reports about all of Sephral’s modules in this world: versions, settings and what the modules recorded, such as the latest chat messages they read. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
DEBUG.Saved: Debug file {file} saved. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
